semiconductor_relevance: High — Scientech GmbH specializes in providing equipment and services for various semiconductor processes, including both front-end and back-end applications.
summary: Scientech GmbH offers a range of packaging and assembly equipment, as well as process equipment for the semiconductor industry. Established to enhance customer service in Europe, the company focuses on providing high-quality support and innovative solutions across multiple high-tech sectors.

regional_presence.Austria: Scientech GmbH was established in Villach, Austria in 2020 to better serve European customers.
